name: trellis-init-provenance-gap
title: Sixty tracked platform files lack any integrity receipt and the gitignore allowlist is fragile
description: 60 tracked platform-dot-dir files (re-measured 2026-08-09; 59 at filing) are uncovered by the union of both existing receipts (.sd-ai-command-pack/provenance.json; .trellis/.template-hashes.json v2, 116 tracked platform paths). Chosen route: repo-local checksum manifest (.github/trellis-provenance.json) + checker (.github/scripts/check-trellis-provenance.py) covering the 53 Trellis-output files plus .gitignore, wired into check.json, make check, and the release-payload-gate CI job, with a git check-ignore --no-index durability assertion for tracked .claude adapter paths. The .claude tracking asymmetry is settled policy (2026-08-04 decision) and stays closed; the .agents trellis-update-spec variant and trellis-start orphan are classified suspected upstream defects, routed via 08-07-vendored-artifact-upstream-route.
creator: sdelmas
